gallery.filename: Secteur du tumulus de Volubilis - Inscription punique - Vue d'ensemble.jpg
gallery.title: File:Secteur du tumulus de Volubilis - Inscription punique - Vue d'ensemble.jpg
gallery.source: Secteur du tumulus de Volubilis - Inscription punique - Vue d'ensemble
gallery.description:
A Punic (Phoenician) inscription from Volubilis, with a double circle (a shield with an umbo?) felief. One or two lines are missing at the beginning. The reading is difficult, and it might be:
[... š]pṭ bn špṭ lʾdnʾ tdršʾ t.nʿm

tšʿmrnʾ bgwd

gallery.title: File:Mosaics in Volubilis.jpg
gallery.description: Many fine houses and public buildings in Volubilis, just as throughout the Roman Empire, were beautifully decorated with mosaics and frescoes.  The frescoes are gone, but many mosaics remain. This is the mosaic of the Four Seasons

gallery.title: File:Basilica and Capitoline Temple.jpg
gallery.description: The Basilica and Capitoline Temple as seen from the top of the Tumulus, a sacred area which, it is said, served as the burial mound for the people of Volubilis before it was built as a Roman town.

Stitched 8 photos together with Autostitch.
